rows: Compile the program once, not again after a step that changed only a livelit's model: keep the compiled program, and give it the new models.
126 to 141 ms of the page's thread after each step (build 8).

done (7f5add1519, 3e51af567f): kept at every step on the Witch, 5 of 5; 34 to 51 ms of comparing after the paint in place of 126 to 141 ms of compiling. Next: a cheaper comparison, since 27 to 39 ms of it copies the program.
Leave the worker out when the compiled run has answered: keep the run's answers when the worker catches up, and hold the worker's request until the steps stop.
The page drawing every livelit again from the worker's answer, to the same picture; the worker's run for each step of a quick series.

partly done (7f5add1519): the answers are kept each time the worker catches up (10 on the Witch) and its request is held 400 ms. But each of the worker's two messages still costs the page a calculate and a whole view, 95 to 143 ms a view, now drawing every livelit from the kept answers: 403 to 543 ms of the page's work after the picture, against 367 to 405 on build 8. What is left is step 1's.
Send values as data where they cross: the worker's answer and its probe samples without ids, holes or closures.
